attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 15 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The corpus keeps no Doulas; this is the martyr of Praetoriada in Cilicia under the eparch Maximus, not the ascetic Doulas of the Egyptian desert, whom saint.gr keeps elsewhere and who has no folder here. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
